purpose: Inventory and integrity baseline for browser libraries committed under lib/.

dependencies.name: docx
dependencies.note: lib/docx.min.js is dist/index.iife.js of the docx 9.15.3 npm tarball, byte for byte, so its SHA-256 matches upstream. The bundle carries no version string of its own, and the 0.155.0 inside it belongs to @oxc-project/runtime, a build-toolchain dependency, so identify a docx file by hashing, never by reading it. Up to 9.7.1 the package published only a UMD build (dist/index.umd.cjs) and this file was that build with its UMD wrapper replaced locally by a plain IIFE assigning 'var docx'. The 9.15 package ships that same IIFE as dist/index.iife.js, and applying the old wrapper swap to 9.15.3's dist/index.umd.cjs was verified to reproduce it byte for byte, so there is no longer any local modification. When upgrading, take dist/index.iife.js from the new release and check the tarball against the registry's dist.integrity. The app uses only the main entry (Document, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun, Packer, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, AlignmentType); the optional sub-entry bundles published since 9.11 (shapes, charts, math, layout, html, macros, watermarks, bibliography, embedded-files) are deliberately not vendored.

dependencies.name: mammoth
dependencies.note: Version established by hashing, not by reading a version string, and the string in this bundle is a trap. lib/mammoth.browser.min.js contains var VERSION="1.13.1", which belongs to the underscore.js it bundles - not to mammoth (mammoth 1.13.0 happens to share the leading digits, which makes the string more misleading, not less). That string was recorded here as mammoth's version and declared in package.json, where it cannot resolve, so Dependabot silently watched nothing for this package. The bundle byte-matched mammoth 1.6.0, which is inside the affected range of CVE-2025-11849 (GHSA-rmjr-87wv-gf87, directory traversal via an image with an external r:link, patched in 1.11.0). Upgraded to 1.12.3 in v3.63.550, then to 1.13.0 (which replaces bluebird with native promises, so the bundle shrank from about 637 KB to 405 KB), each verified by hashing the published mammoth.browser.min.js from the registry tarball. Confirm the same way on any future bump: the version inside the file is not mammoth's.

dependencies.name: pdfjs-dist-classic
dependencies.note: Pinned at 3.11.174 because that is the last pdfjs-dist major to publish a classic (non-module) build, and browsers refuse ESM imports across file:// origins. It loads ONLY on file://, and the runtime mitigation for CVE-2024-4367 is isEvalSupported:false, passed at every getDocument() call site. Upgrading this is not a matter of picking a newer version: no newer version exists in a form that can load here without adding a build step. cveFloor is null deliberately: this build is permanently pinned below the fix for GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq (CVE-2024-4367) because pdfjs-dist has published ESM only since 4.x and browsers refuse module imports across file:// origins. The mitigation is isEvalSupported:false at every getDocument() call site, asserted separately by the gate. A floor here would fail every build.

dependencies.name: pdfjs-dist-esm
dependencies.note: The build served over http(s). pdfjs-dist ships ESM only from 4.x onward — there is no classic build in any 4.x, 5.x or 6.x release, which is why the file:// fallback below is pinned to the last major that had one.
